home.subtitle: Manage your projects and investments now!
home.keepFocus: Stay on track, don't lose focus.
home.faq1q: How do I create a new project?
home.faq1a: To create a new project, click the "Create Project" button on the home page or in the navigation menu. Fill in the necessary information such as name, budget, and project category.
home.faq2q: How do I manage my budget?
home.faq2a: COSTS lets you track your expenses in real time. You can add services and costs to each project, and the system will automatically calculate how much of your budget has already been used.
home.faq3q: Can I edit a project after creating it?
home.faq3a: Yes! You can edit the project information, add or remove services, and update the budget at any time through the project details page.
home.faq4q: How do I filter my projects?
home.faq4a: On the projects page, you'll find filter options that let you organize your projects by category, status, or budget amount.
home.faq5a: Yes, COSTS is a free tool to help you efficiently manage your projects and personal finances.
